gaps.sentence: Her ___ (JUDGE) of character is rarely wrong.
gaps.explanation: 'Her judgement of character' — the noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: He made a ___ mistake and lost all the data (CARE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -less means without: careless means not taking care. It modifies the noun 'mistake'.

gaps.sentence: When the costs rose, we had to ___ our plans (CONSIDER).
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again: reconsider means to think about something again. A base verb follows 'had to'.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ to smoke inside public buildings (LEGAL).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: against the law (il-)
gaps.explanation: The negative of 'legal' is 'illegal' (il- before l). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: The island is ___ , with no permanent residents (HABIT).
gaps.explanation: 'No permanent residents' shows the negative: uninhabited (un- + inhabited). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTERVIEW) asked her some difficult questions.
gaps.hint: the person who asks the questions (-er = doer)
gaps.explanation: The interviewer asks; the interviewee answers. The suffix -er marks the doer.
The prefix un- forms the negative adjective: unusual. An adjective is needed after 'was'.

gaps.sentence: We ___ the cost of the trip and ran out of money (ESTIMATE).
gaps.hint: judged it too low — that is why the money ran out (under-)
gaps.explanation: Running out of money shows the estimate was too low: underestimated (under- + estimated).
